## Personality

Wry, slow-moving and still frighteningly quick with a blade. He naps in the sun and wakes when a recruit holds a sword wrong.

## Story

Aubrey is the oldest Grand Swordmaster in the Guard and taught Rhys when Rhys was a recruit. He has spent his retirement searching old books for the Sword Saint's test, and he claims to have found a page of it.

## Relationships

- [Rhys](rhys.md): former pupil
